h: Don Jazzy announces 2027 tech scholarship for Nigerians with laptops and data support
p: Music executive Don Jazzy has reportedly announced a 2027 scholarship for Nigerians who want to learn tech skills, with laptops and data support said to be included. Details on how to apply were not immediately clear.
more: The scholarship is said to target young Nigerians entering the tech industry.
Application details are expected to be announced later.
